grades.reason: This passage describes LoongArch LL.ACQ/SC.REL acquire/release semantics. The query asks about RISC-V aq and rl bits, so the ISA is wrong.

grades.quote: If both bits are clear, no additional ordering constraints are imposed on the atomic memory operation. If only the _aq_ bit is set, the atomic memory operation is treated as an _acquire_ access, i.e., no following memory operations on this RISC-V hart can be observed to take place before the acquire memory operation. If only the _rl_ bit is set, the atomic memory operation is treated as a _release_ access, i.e., the release memory operation cannot be observed to take place before any earlier memory operations on this RISC-V hart.
grades.reason: This passage directly defines the aq and rl bits on RISC-V atomic instructions. It covers each case: both clear, aq only (acquire), rl only (release), and both set (sequentially consistent).
